$description: TimeZoneSelect (platform/components/TimeZoneSelect, library wave 7, lane C): its component tokens. The field, list, group headings and options are the Combobox's own tokens.

time-zone-select-option-gap.$description: TimeZoneSelect: the space between a zone's city and its offset.

time-zone-select-offset-text.$description: TimeZoneSelect: a zone's offset from UTC (UTC−08:00), secondary text.

time-zone-select-offset-font-family.$description: TimeZoneSelect: offsets are technical values: the data font (Reddit Mono).

time-zone-select-offset-font-size.$description: TimeZoneSelect: the size of an offset (the data font one step under the option's text).

time-zone-select-offset-font-weight.$description: TimeZoneSelect: the offset stays regular in the chosen option.

time-zone-select-field-offset-margin-inl.$description: TimeZoneSelect: the room between the field's offset and the chevron.
